none: PAS CAM-F49EC5: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy radiate of Postumus, AD 260-269
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [ORIENS AVG] ; D/ IMP C P[OSTVMVS P F] AVG

A copper-alloy radiate of Postumus, AD 260-269 (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads [ORIENS AVG]. Reverse shows Sol advancing left, raising right hand and holdingwhip in left. Mint of Gaul I. See Cunnetio cf.p.145, no.2454. Obverse legend reads IMP C P[OSTVMVS P F] AVG. Obverse shows a radiate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.93g, diameter 20.2mm, thickness…
